t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes size, position and hats are irrelevant to the game. The gnomes appear in pairs. Red,green, blue and orange go to the bright forest and the other colour gnomes go to the dark forest. I need to note which type of forest delivers the most mushrooms throughout the game and try to select the colour gnomes that lead me there.

vb_textbox.text: Hello! These are the following tips that I found when I was playing the game. Hopefully, they will help you to be successful when playing. 1. The gnomes always appear in the same set of two colours: blue and purple, yellow and red, brown and orange and green and pink. The purple, yellow and pink gnomes seemed to gather the most mushrooms out of their respective pairs. However, I found the success of the brown and orange mushrooms to change quite frequently. 2. This led me to question whether another aspect of the gnomes' character led to a higher yield of mushrooms. I began to think that the gnomes with the shorter hats collected more mushrooms compared to gnomes with the taller hat. This seemed to be effective for a while in the game, but again, their were some inconsistencies with this method. 3. Short yellow hat gnome seemed to gather lots of mushrooms each time. 4. I didn't notice a particular pattern with the positioning of the gnomes, but this may be something you may want to consider if looking for another pattern. Keep focused and should gain lots of mushrooms. Good luck!
